tooltip.shieldrpg.viking_roundshield.lor: Sturdy pine rimmed with raw iron, painted in traditional raven spirals.
tooltip.shieldrpg.svalinn_frost_oak_shie: Carved from ancient frost-oak kissed by Svalinn's chill. Slows attackers on impact.
Massive bulwark of petrified Ironwood timber. An immovable bastion against projectiles at the cost of mobility.
tooltip.shieldrpg.aegis_of_the_shieldmai: Blessed by the battle-maidens of Folkvangr. Perfect parries channel holy vigor to restore vitality.
tooltip.shieldrpg.viking_roundshield.ski: A Perfect Guard on a melee attacker strikes it back for %2$s damage.
tooltip.shieldrpg.svalinn_frost_oak_shie: Attackers you block are slowed for %2$s seconds.
tooltip.shieldrpg.aegis_of_the_shieldmai: A Perfect Guard heals %2$s%% of your max health (once every %1$s seconds).
Blocking a projectile sends it back at the shooter.
tooltip.shieldrpg.wooden_buckler.lore.1: A small round shield of seasoned oak. Light and quick, but it will not stop much.
tooltip.shieldrpg.iron_heater_shield.lor: A classic iron-bound shield. It turns arrows better than it turns swords.
tooltip.shieldrpg.copper_roundel.skill.r: A fully charged attack with this shield hits the target for %2$s extra damage (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.copper_roundel.lore.1: Beaten copper with a sharpened rim.
tooltip.shieldrpg.skirmisher_pelta.skill: When a projectile is about to hit you, you gain speed for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
A crescent shield carried by light skirmishers who never stand still.
tooltip.shieldrpg.thornback_scutum.skill: Melee attackers you block take %2$s damage (every %1$s seconds).
Studded with iron spikes. Hitting it hurts.
tooltip.shieldrpg.frostguard_pavise.skil: Blocking a projectile slows its shooter for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.frostguard_pavise.lore: A tall archer's wall rimed with frost that never melts.
tooltip.shieldrpg.stormcaller_aspis.skil: A Perfect Guard strikes nearby enemies for %2$s damage, knocks them back and weakens them for %4$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.stormcaller_aspis.lore: Bronze etched with a storm. It answers a perfect parry with thunder.
tooltip.shieldrpg.sunforged_bulwark.skil: When the guard is nearly broken you heal %2$s%% of your max health and gain Absorption for %3$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.sunforged_bulwark.lore: Gold that holds the heat of the sun, and gives it back when you are about to fall.
tooltip.shieldrpg.wardens_greatshield.sk: A fully charged attack with this shield deals %2$s extra damage and knocks the target back (every %1$s seconds).
When the guard recovers you gain Resistance for %2$s seconds.
tooltip.shieldrpg.wardens_greatshield.lo: Forged for the wardens who held the pass. It has never been carried by anyone who ran.
tooltip.shieldrpg.vanguard_kite.skill.st: Blocking a hit grants Regeneration for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.vanguard_kite.lore.1: Long and pointed, built to be planted in the ground while the line holds.
tooltip.shieldrpg.ironhide_targe.skill.s: A hit that gets past your shield's blocking angle grants you Absorption for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.ironhide_targe.lore.1: Tanned thick. The blows that get past it feel like less.
tooltip.shieldrpg.duelists_parma.skill.b: Raising the shield grants Strength for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.duelists_parma.lore.1: Raise it to commit. A duelist's shield is half of the dance.
Taking up the shield grants Speed for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
Swung to the arm when the road turns bad.
tooltip.shieldrpg.reservoir_bulwark.skil: When your stamina runs out you gain strong Absorption for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.reservoir_bulwark.lore: Built around a deep well of stamina. When the well runs dry, it still gives.
tooltip.shieldrpg.phoenix_heart_shield.s: When the shield breaks you heal %2$s%% of your max health, gain Regeneration for %3$s seconds and knock nearby enemies back.
tooltip.shieldrpg.phoenix_heart_shield.l: It burns out only once. What rises from it keeps you alive.
tooltip.shieldrpg.duelists_buckler.skill: Lowering the shield grants Haste for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
Drop it to finish. The other half of the dance.
tooltip.shieldrpg.pilgrims_roundshield.s: Putting the shield away grants Jump Boost for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.pilgrims_roundshield.l: Slung on the back for the long road.
tooltip.shieldrpg.wellspring_bulwark.ski: When the guard is fully restored you heal %2$s%% of your max health (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.wellspring_bulwark.lor: A spring that refills the moment it is whole.
tooltip.shieldrpg.shieldmaidens_last_sta: When the guard breaks, nearby enemies are knocked back and you gain Absorption for %3$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
Carried by the shieldmaidens who held the line when the Aegis itself was cracked.
tooltip.shieldrpg.wooden_buckler.skill.t: A Perfect Guard marks the attacker so it glows for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.iron_heater_shield.ski: A fully charged attack with this shield shoves the target back (every %1$s seconds).
A Perfect Guard gives you speed for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.standard_shield.lore.1: The plain wooden shield every soldier knows. It replaces the vanilla recipe.
tooltip.shieldrpg.vanilla_shield.lore.1: The plain shield of the base game, now with a skill and armor.
tooltip.shieldrpg.vanilla_shield.skill.r: A Perfect Guard gives you speed for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.bastion_shield.skill.d: Melee attackers you block are weakened for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.bastion_shield.lore.1: Five straight sides and no clever ideas. It holds the line.
tooltip.shieldrpg.bannermans_standard.sk: A fully charged attack with this shield blinds the target for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.bannermans_standard.lo: Cloth snaps in the face of whoever stands too close.
tooltip.shieldrpg.wicker_oval.skill.arro: Blocking a projectile heals you for %2$s health (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.wicker_oval.lore.1: Woven tight enough that arrows get stuck instead of bouncing.
When a hit gets past your shield you heal %2$s health (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.crusaders_cross.lore.1: A cross-shaped plate. What it misses, it forgives.
tooltip.shieldrpg.spearpoint_shield.skil: A fully charged attack with this shield hits the target for %2$s damage and slows it for %3$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.spearpoint_shield.lore: Pointed down like a blade. It goes for the legs.
tooltip.shieldrpg.gatehouse_shield.skill: When the guard is nearly broken, nearby enemies are shoved back and slowed for %3$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
Flat on top, like a portcullis.
tooltip.shieldrpg.forge_twins_roundel.sk: When the guard is fully charged you gain Fire Resistance for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.forge_twins_roundel.lo: Two discs hammered out together. Neither one has ever been cold.
tooltip.shieldrpg.leaf_shield.skill.verd: A Perfect Guard grants Regeneration for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.leaf_shield.lore.1: Moss-grown and light. It likes being struck at just the right moment.
tooltip.shieldrpg.sunburst_targe.skill.s: Blocking a projectile hurts every nearby enemy for %2$s damage (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.sunburst_targe.lore.1: Eight points, all of them aimed outward.
A Perfect Guard grants Resistance for %2$s seconds and Regeneration for %4$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.cathedral_aegis.lore.1: Pointed like a window of stained glass. Inside it, nothing touches you.
tooltip.shieldrpg.beacon_aegis.skill.bea: Two Perfect Guards in a row fire a beam at your attacker for %2$s damage (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.beacon_aegis.lore.1: A shield that stores light. Two perfect guards in a row let it out.
tooltip.shieldrpg.creeper_face.skill.sss: A Perfect Guard makes the shield explode: nearby enemies take %3$s damage and are knocked back, blocks stay intact (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.creeper_face.lore.1: Stolen from a creeper that got too close. It still wants to hug you.
tooltip.shieldrpg.slime_bouncer.skill.bo: Melee attackers you block are bounced away (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.cactus_buckler.skill.s: Blocking a hit pricks every enemy around you for %2$s damage (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.cactus_buckler.lore.1: Do not hug. Do not hit. Do not touch.
tooltip.shieldrpg.wither_skull_buckler.s: Melee attackers you block wither for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.wither_skull_buckler.l: Its empty sockets watch whoever hits it. Nobody enjoys it.
tooltip.shieldrpg.jack_o_shield.skill.fr: When the guard breaks, nearby enemies are blinded for %2$s seconds and weakened (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.jack_o_shield.lore.1: Carved with a very rude face. The grin glows when it is about to give way.
tooltip.shieldrpg.piston_ram.skill.pisto: A fully charged attack with this shield launches the target back and into the air (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.piston_ram.lore.1: Sticky piston, bolted to a door. It pushes back harder than it was built to.
tooltip.shieldrpg.pufferfish_buckler.ski: Melee attackers you block are poisoned for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.pufferfish_buckler.lor: Still puffed up. Do not poke.
tooltip.shieldrpg.turtle_shell_shield.sk: When the guard is nearly broken you gain strong Resistance for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.turtle_shell_shield.lo: Slow, heavy and very hard to crack.
tooltip.shieldrpg.ender_eye_shield.skill: The shooter of a projectile you block is blinded for %2$s seconds, however far away (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.blaze_shield.skill.sco: Melee attackers you block are set on fire for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.blaze_shield.lore.1: Bolted together from blaze rods. Warm to the touch.
tooltip.shieldrpg.prismarine_shield.skil: Putting the shield away grants Dolphin's Grace for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.prismarine_shield.lore: Cut from an ocean monument. It still smells of salt.
tooltip.shieldrpg.phantom_wing_shield.sk: When the guard breaks, nearby enemies are lifted into the air for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.phantom_wing_shield.lo: Membrane stretched over a bone frame. It is almost weightless.
tooltip.shieldrpg.cobweb_shield.skill.re: The shooter of a projectile you block is yanked toward you (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.cobweb_shield.lore.1: Spun by something much bigger than a spider.
tooltip.shieldrpg.golden_apple_shield.sk: When the guard recovers you gain Health Boost for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.golden_apple_shield.lo: Too shiny to eat. It is also too hard.
tooltip.shieldrpg.bell_shield.skill.clea: Raising the shield rings the bell and removes every harmful effect from you (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.bell_shield.lore.1: Taken from the village square. The villagers want it back.
tooltip.shieldrpg.lantern_shield.skill.l: Taking up the shield grants Night Vision for %2$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.lantern_shield.lore.1: Hold it up and the dark backs off a little.
tooltip.shieldrpg.tavern_door.skill.boun: A Perfect Guard throws every enemy around you out the door (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.tavern_door.lore.1: Torn off its hinges. Surprisingly good at shoving drunks, and enemies.
tooltip.shieldrpg.cast_iron_pan.skill.cl: A Perfect Guard rings the pan against the attacker for %2$s damage and weakens it for %3$s seconds (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.barrel_lid.skill.snack: Blocking a projectile fills your hunger bar (every %1$s seconds).
tooltip.shieldrpg.barrel_lid.lore.1: Better than nothing, which is what the last owner had.
